story: I have a job interview tomorrow, and I am afraid I will fail.
My final exam is next week, but I cannot focus when I try to study.
My boyfriend stopped responding to my messages, and I do not know what happened.
My parents keep comparing me with my sister.
Nothing specific is wrong, but I feel worried and tense all day.
My close friend passed away, and I miss her every day.
I moved to a new city and have nobody to spend time with.
I always compare myself with others and feel like I am not talented enough.
My credit-card balance keeps increasing, and I cannot afford all my bills.
I have not been sleeping well and feel exhausted every morning.
I want to become more disciplined and stop giving up on my goals.
The grocery store was crowded today, and the long line annoyed me.
